NHIS is an annual, nationally representative, household survey of the noninstitutionalized U.S. civilian population.

methods_quotes.q: Data were weighted to account for complex survey design and provide nationally representative estimates.
SAS-callable SUDAAN software (version 11.0.3; RTI International) was used to conduct all analyses.
Estimates were calculated overall and by sex, age, race/ethnicity, U.S. Census region,
Estimates with a relative standard error >30% or unweighted denominator <50 are suppressed.
